name: rusender
description: Управление email-рассылками RuSender из ассистента: статистика кампаний, база контактов, сегменты, A/B-тесты, домены и доставляемость.

interface.longDescription:
RuSender is a Russian email marketing platform for marketing campaigns and transactional email. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your RuSender account through a remote MCP server so you can build, launch and analyze campaigns without leaving the chat.

What it covers:
- Campaigns: create drafts, attach templates, senders and contact lists, preview audience splits, send now or on schedule, run A/B subject-line tests, send in growing daily chunks, resend to non-openers, archive and organize into folders.
- Contacts and lists: search, read and update contacts, import up to 1000 rows per call with custom variables, move contacts between lists, unsubscribe and resubscribe, view per-contact sending history.
- Segments and variables: build dynamic segments by conditions, define custom contact fields per list.
- Transactional email: send by key with inline HTML or a saved template, list past sends with delivery status, aggregated stats per key.
- Deliverability: add sending domains, get DKIM/SPF/DMARC records, verify DNS, manage senders and webhooks.
- Analytics: campaign funnel, opens and clicks over time, per-link clicks, stats by recipient mail provider (Gmail, Mail.ru, Yandex and others).

The plugin also bundles skills: step-by-step campaign creation, A/B subject-line tests split by mail provider, campaign list cleanup, and visual reports for a single campaign, an A/B test, the whole account, a campaign timeline and a transactional sending key, plus a seasonal Japanese-style email template and a tongue-in-cheek send-date oracle. Reports are delivered as an HTML file or as tables in the chat.

Authorization is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE: each user signs in to their own RuSender account and can revoke access at any time. A RuSender account is required to connect; sending real email also requires a confirmed sender address or a verified sending domain. Sending and deletion tools are annotated as destructive, so ChatGPT asks for confirmation before running them. The interface of RuSender itself is in Russian.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission. RuSender remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE) with tools for email campaigns, contacts and lists, segments, transactional email, sending domains (DKIM/SPF/DMARC), webhooks and analytics, plus 10 bundled skills that work in both ChatGPT and Claude: each report skill picks its output by the tools available (published page, HTML file or tables in chat). Sending and deletion tools are annotated as destructive.
